name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.download.SpeechVoiceDownloadLandingClockActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an app-download ad selects the clock landing design. It shows the advertised app's download offer in a timed clock-style layout.
disableEffect: The clock-style app-download landing page will no longer open.
